The '''Nord system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was located within the [[Kanz sector/Legends|Kanz sector]], in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="EAOC" /> and [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]] regions of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="TEA" /> The [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] known as [[Iceman]], who operated in the [[Minos Cluster/Legends|Minos Cluster]] shortly after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], hailed from the Nord system.<ref name="GG6-2">[[Galaxy Guide 6: Tramp Freighters (Second Edition)|''Galaxy Guide 6: Tramp Freighters'', Second Edition]]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Nord system was first mentioned in the [[1990]] sourcebook ''[[Galaxy Guide 6: Tramp Freighters]]'', which was written by [[Mark Rein-Hagen]] and [[Stewart Wieck]] for [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="GG6">''[[Galaxy Guide 6: Tramp Freighters]]''</ref> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the system in grid square N-4.<ref name="TEA" />
